line: Commander, an iron asteroid field. Its rocks are veined with glowing ore, and it's our best source of metal, and of Reinforced Alloy for the forge. Send Haulers to mine it, and keep watch: a rival can attack whoever holds the field.
Commander, a crystal comet. Its icy core bristles with crystal, so this is where we mine crystal, and Quantum Crystal for the forge. Send Haulers, and hold it until their holds are full.
Commander, a gas cloud. Our Haulers skim it for gas, the fuel every fleet burns in flight. It yields slowly, so send plenty of Haulers and keep them safe.
